issues.detail: The Greek text uses the plural 'μετ αυτων' (with them), but the Vietnamese translation uses 'với mình' (with themselves/us), which can be ambiguous or singular in context. More importantly, the Greek 'παραγενομενοι' is a plural participle ('having come'), while the Vietnamese 'hai người' (two people) adds a specific number not present in the Greek text.
